title: Overnight Gap
briefing: Tidal Power trades quietly at about $31. Watch what happens to the price when big news arrives and buyers rush in.
objective: Prices move when buyers and sellers change their minds. News overnight can make the price gap.
debrief: On day 11 Tidal Power won a 20-year solar contract. Buyers suddenly outnumbered sellers, so the stock gapped up about 5% at the open and kept climbing for several days as more buyers arrived. Nobody could buy at the old price: the gap was already in the first price you could trade at. Buying soon after the news still caught the follow-through.

news.headline: Tidal Power wins a 20-year state solar contract
news.body: The state has picked Tidal Power to supply solar energy for the next 20 years. It is the biggest contract in the company's history.

basic.text: Buy within 3 days of the contract headline
